name: Publisher KV Publication and GitHub Completion Notification

notification_contract.purpose: trigger GitHub notification email according to account notification settings
notification_contract.subject_semantics: Goal Task completed and Publisher documentation added to KV
notification_contract.files_section: exact file names or canonical KV object names written by Publisher
notification_contract.kv_link: stable resolvable link/reference returned by the successful KV publication step

kv_email_monitor_contract.monitor_runtime_state: MUST_BE_AUTHENTICALLY_OBSERVED; source configuration alone does not prove ACTIVE
kv_email_monitor_contract.required_behavior: GitHub emails that are not errors or failures must still be retained/indexed for task and publication tracking rather than discarded as non-actionable
kv_email_monitor_contract.tracking_record_semantics: observational/indexing only; email receipt or classification does not authorize a state transition
kv_email_monitor_contract.duplicate_semantics: deduplicate by stable provider message identity when available; otherwise use normalized immutable email digest plus account scope
kv_email_monitor_contract.retention_semantics: retain non-error/non-failure GitHub emails needed to reconstruct completion/publication history

retry_or_reentry_semantics.github_notification: emit_once_after_verified_KV_publication_receipt; retry provider delivery without rewriting KV when the same publication receipt is retained
retry_or_reentry_semantics.kv_email_tracking: email-monitor retries must not resend the GitHub notification; reobserve/reindex the same provider message idempotently
retry_or_reentry_semantics.never: do not send completion notification before verified KV publication and do not claim email tracking complete without an observed KV email-monitor receipt

repeatability_cardinality: optional reusable terminal component; at most once per completed Goal Task publication set unless a new artifact revision is explicitly declared; email tracking may reobserve idempotently
